method: staged constrained IK warm-start plus minimum-jerk multiple shooting and inverse-dynamics contact-wrench feasibility
contact_force_solver: bounded nonlinear least-squares with positive-normal/circular-friction-cone parameterization
dynamics_source: MuJoCo mj_inverse, checked against Isaac-captured limits
reason: SciPy and MuJoCo were already installed; CasADi, Pinocchio, IPOPT and NLopt were unavailable, so no new large dependency was introduced
limitations: phase durations were selected from bounded trials, not jointly optimized
MuJoCo collision meshes are a proxy for the Isaac USD
contact force solve is knot-wise rather than a single sparse NLP
